items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Or maybe 40, I don’t know. No, that is true. See that I remember things that are so precious, you know. You don’t forget. You know that, “How ya doin’, Bob Chops?” You know? Or Charlie Parker saying, “Man, you know I told Benny… Benny, you know, he’s not the Bee Gees, a motherfucker.” Charlie Parker in your ear. And you were trying to forget that. [laughs] But I… This is… and me sharing, when we played the Billie Holiday show at the… No, the Dinah Washington all-star show in the theater in Philadelphia, he asked…
Yeah. Let’s call it a day. How are you gonna top that? [laughs] Talking about…
